The '''Restricted Customs Area''' was a customs-related location in [[Spaceport THX1138]], near the boarding gates. It was restricted to starport personnel.

==Behind the scenes==
The door to the Restricted Customs Area can be seen in the [[Tokyo Disneyland]] version of ''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]''. It is a restricted area for Disneyland staff members.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]'' {{C|Tokyo only}}
